quests.question: This person studies a case and speaks in court on behalf of someone else. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies a case and speaks in court on behalf of someone else. Who is it?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a lawyer. Lawyers help and speak for people who need help with the law.
quests.funFact: A lawyer reads carefully through many papers before every case.
quests.wordExample: The lawyer helped explain the contract to her client.

quests.question: This person studies the sky and tells everyone what the weather will be. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies the sky and tells everyone what the weather will be. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a meteorologist. Meteorologists study the sky and tell us what the weather will be.
quests.funFact: Meteorologists study clouds, wind, and temperature every single day.
quests.wordExample: The meteorologist explained why the sky looked so cloudy today.

quests.question: This person wears a helmet and drives a very fast car around a track. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person wears a helmet and drives a very fast car around a track. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: A race car driver can travel faster than almost any other kind of car!
quests.wordExample: The race car driver zoomed around the track.

quests.question: This person rolls fresh paint onto walls to give a room a new look. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person rolls fresh paint onto walls to give a room a new look. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a house painter. House painters paint the walls of homes and buildings.
quests.funFact: House painters carefully cover furniture before they start painting.
quests.wordExample: The house painter chose a bright blue for my bedroom.

quests.question: This person carves or shapes stone, wood, or metal into a work of art. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person carves or shapes stone, wood, or metal into a work of art. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a sculptor. Sculptors carve or shape material like stone or metal into art.
quests.funFact: Sculptors sometimes make a small clay model before carving the real statue.
quests.wordExample: The sculptor shaped the clay model before starting the real statue.

quests.question: This person studies rocks and the layers that make up the Earth. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies rocks and the layers that make up the Earth. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a geologist. Geologists study rocks and the layers that make up the Earth.
quests.funFact: Geologists study how mountains and canyons formed over millions of years.
quests.wordExample: The geologist explained how the canyon formed over time.

quests.question: This person fixes wires and makes sure your lights turn on safely. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person fixes wires and makes sure your lights turn on safely. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an electrician. Electricians install and repair the wires that bring us electricity.
quests.funFact: Electricians wear special gloves to stay safe while they work.
quests.wordExample: The electrician fixed the flickering light in our kitchen.

quests.question: This person shows families around houses and helps them find the right home to buy. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person shows families around houses and helps them find the right home to buy. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a real estate agent. Real estate agents help people find and buy the right home.
quests.funFact: A real estate agent might show a family dozens of homes before they find the right one!
quests.wordExample: The real estate agent showed us a house for sale.

quests.question: This person uses a boat, a net, or a fishing rod to catch fish. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person uses a boat, a net, or a fishing rod to catch fish. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a fisherman. Fishermen catch fish from the sea, rivers, or lakes.
quests.funFact: A fisherman must be very patient while waiting for a fish to bite!
quests.wordExample: The fisherman sailed out early to catch fresh fish.

quests.question: This person counts money and helps customers at a bank counter. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person counts money and helps customers at a bank counter. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a bank teller. Bank tellers help customers deposit and withdraw their money.
quests.funFact: A bank teller counts money quickly and very carefully.
quests.wordExample: The bank teller counted the money carefully.

quests.question: This person draws the plan for a new building before workers start to build it. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person draws the plan for a new building before workers start to build it. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is an architect. Architects design buildings before workers start to build them.
quests.funFact: Some architects build tiny models of a building before it's ever built.
quests.wordExample: The architect showed us a model of the new school.

quests.question: This person draws hundreds of pictures to make a cartoon character move. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person draws hundreds of pictures to make a cartoon character move. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an animator. Animators draw and design characters so they appear to move.
quests.funFact: Animators bring cartoon characters to life one drawing at a time.
quests.wordExample: The animator made the character's smile look just right.

quests.question: This person listens to spoken words in one language and instantly says them in another. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person listens to spoken words in one language and instantly says them in another. Who is it?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is an interpreter. Interpreters listen in one language and speak the meaning in another right away.
quests.funFact: An interpreter has to think and translate at almost the same time someone is speaking!
quests.wordExample: The interpreter helped the visitor understand the doctor's questions.

quests.question: This person carefully checks and organizes numbers to help track money. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person carefully checks and organizes numbers to help track money. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an accountant. Accountants help track and organize money for people and businesses.
quests.funFact: An accountant checks numbers very carefully to make sure nothing is missing.
quests.wordExample: The accountant checked that all the numbers were correct.

quests.question: This person performs daring tricks and stunts under the big circus tent. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person performs daring tricks and stunts under the big circus tent. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a circus performer. Circus performers amaze audiences with daring tricks and stunts.
quests.funFact: A circus performer trains for years to make daring tricks look easy!
quests.wordExample: The circus performer swung high above the crowd.

quests.question: This person works aboard a ship and helps it travel across the sea. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person works aboard a ship and helps it travel across the sea. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a sailor. Sailors work on a ship and help it travel across the sea.
quests.funFact: Sailors once used the stars at night to help steer their ship!
quests.wordExample: The sailor steered the ship through the calm sea.

quests.question: This person imagines new ideas and writes them down as stories, poems, or articles. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person imagines new ideas and writes them down as stories, poems, or articles. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.
quests.funFact: Some writers write early in the morning when their ideas feel freshest.
quests.wordExample: The writer read the first page of his new book aloud.

quests.question: This person travels to unknown places using a map and compass to explore them. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person travels to unknown places using a map and compass to explore them. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an explorer. Explorers travel to new places to discover and learn about them.
quests.funFact: Some explorers keep detailed journals of every new place they discover.
quests.wordExample: The explorer wrote about the new island in her journal.

quests.question: This person wears a smart suit and helps manage a large household. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person wears a smart suit and helps manage a large household. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a butler. Butlers manage a household and help take care of daily tasks.
quests.funFact: A butler often knows every detail about how a big house runs.
quests.wordExample: The butler greeted the guests at the front door.

quests.question: This person carefully builds and repairs watches using tiny gears. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person carefully builds and repairs watches using tiny gears. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a watchmaker. Watchmakers build and repair watches with tiny, careful parts.
quests.funFact: A watchmaker works with gears so tiny they're smaller than a grain of rice!
quests.wordExample: The watchmaker fixed the tiny gears inside the watch.

quests.question: This person teaches people how to stand up and ride ocean waves on a surfboard. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person teaches people how to stand up and ride ocean waves on a surfboard. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a surf instructor. Surf instructors teach people how to ride ocean waves on a surfboard.
quests.funFact: A surf instructor teaches beginners to catch small, gentle waves first!
quests.wordExample: The surf instructor helped me stand up on the board.

quests.question: This person studies the plants and animals that live in the ocean. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies the plants and animals that live in the ocean. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a marine biologist. Marine biologists study the plants and animals that live in the ocean.
quests.funFact: Marine biologists sometimes discover brand-new sea creatures no one has seen before.
quests.wordExample: The marine biologist tagged a sea turtle to track its journey.

quests.question: This person studies stars and planets from Earth using a powerful telescope. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies stars and planets from Earth using a powerful telescope. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an astronomer. Astronomers study stars, planets, and space using powerful telescopes.
quests.funFact: An astronomer can spot a star that is millions of miles away!
quests.wordExample: The astronomer pointed the telescope at a bright new star.

quests.question: This person wears a hard hat and helps build houses, roads, and tall buildings. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person wears a hard hat and helps build houses, roads, and tall buildings. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a construction worker. Construction workers build houses, roads, and tall buildings.
quests.funFact: It can take hundreds of construction workers to build one tall building!
quests.wordExample: The construction workers built a new school near our house.

quests.question: This person carries a bag of letters and packages and delivers them to your door. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person carries a bag of letters and packages and delivers them to your door. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a mail carrier. Mail carriers deliver letters and packages to homes every day.
quests.funFact: A mail carrier can deliver mail to hundreds of homes in one day!
quests.wordExample: The mail carrier dropped a letter into our mailbox.

quests.question: This person uses a needle and thread to sew clothes so they fit just right. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person uses a needle and thread to sew clothes so they fit just right. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a tailor. Tailors sew and fix clothes so they fit just right.
quests.funFact: A tailor measures your body carefully so clothes fit perfectly.
quests.wordExample: The tailor shortened the sleeves on my new jacket.

quests.question: This person studies clues carefully and figures out what really happened. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies clues carefully and figures out what really happened. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a detective. Detectives look for clues and solve mysteries.
quests.funFact: A detective looks closely at tiny clues that other people might miss.
quests.wordExample: The detective studied every clue at the scene.

quests.question: This person digs up and studies fossils from animals that lived millions of years ago. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person digs up and studies fossils from animals that lived millions of years ago. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a paleontologist. Paleontologists dig up and study fossils from animals that lived long ago.
quests.funFact: A paleontologist might dig for weeks just to find one dinosaur bone!
quests.wordExample: The paleontologist carefully brushed dirt away from the fossil.

quests.question: This person teaches slow stretches, balance, and calm breathing. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person teaches slow stretches, balance, and calm breathing. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a yoga instructor. Yoga instructors teach calm stretches and breathing exercises.
quests.funFact: A yoga instructor teaches poses named after animals, like the cat or cobra!
quests.wordExample: The yoga instructor showed us a calm breathing exercise.

quests.question: This scientist studies insects like ants, beetles, and butterflies. Who is it?
quests.hint: This scientist studies insects like ants, beetles, and butterflies. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an entomologist. Entomologists study insects like ants, beetles, and butterflies.
quests.funFact: Entomologists sometimes discover brand-new kinds of insects nobody has seen before.
quests.wordExample: The entomologist gently caught a beetle to study it.
